fields.title: 6. Three data points to verify directly before the next issue (monthly 2026-11, 11/01)
fields.md:
1. **EDGAR 8-K Item 1.01/2.03 + Ex.10** — If a master financial lease is signed: fixed rate, number of tranches, call/early termination, purchase option. If present, review proposed new rule ② ([EDGAR 8-K list](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001181412&type=8-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=10)).
2. **Official Starlink US residential pricing + Amazon Leo Vulcan LV-01 (10/29) result** — Prepare the T4 checkpoint on 12/01 (source: Section 6 of the previous issue).
3. **Lease and non-cancellable commitment notes in the 4Q26 10-K** — Whether GPU leases overlap with the 2027 non-cancellable commitments of $25.57 billion, and how lease liabilities are recognized (ruling on proposal ③) (compare against the [10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/spcx-20260930.htm)).
